note: Which providers Visual Atlas may collect from, and why. atlas/rights.py applies each enabled provider's rule to every item; anything that does not meet the rule is ineligible. 'checked_on' is when a person last read the evidence pages. Re-check before changing a status.

providers.name: Art Institute of Chicago
providers.rule: Artwork record has is_public_domain == true and an image_id. Image fetched from the IIIF service at 843 px wide (AIC's recommended cached size).
providers.label: CC0 — source checked
providers.attribution: Not legally required; AIC asks for a caption: Artist, Title, Date. The Art Institute of Chicago.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: Public-domain status covers the artwork image only; AIC's text 'description' field is CC BY 4.0 and is attributed if shown.
providers.notes: IIIF image requests must send the AIC-User-Agent header (their documented courtesy header); without it the CDN challenges automated clients, which Visual Atlas never tries to bypass. Keep to about 1 request per second.

providers.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
providers.rule: Object record has isPublicDomain == true and a primaryImage URL on images.metmuseum.org.
providers.label: CC0 — source checked
providers.attribution: Not legally required; credit included: Artist, Title, Date. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Credit line.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: Only objects The Met marks public domain; other objects are skipped.
providers.notes: The /v1/search endpoint was retired on 2026-10-01; Visual Atlas uses /v1.1/search (paginated) and checks isPublicDomain on each object. Stay well under 80 requests per second.

providers.name: Cleveland Museum of Art
providers.rule: Artwork record has share_license_status == 'CC0' and images.web.url on openaccess-cdn.clevelandart.org.
providers.label: CC0 — source checked
providers.attribution: Not legally required; credit included: Artist, Title, Date. The Cleveland Museum of Art.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.notes: The image CDN returned HTTP 521 during the 2026-10-15 check (temporary outage); jobs record such failures and move on.

providers.name: Smithsonian Open Access
providers.rule: The image media item itself has usage.access == 'CC0' (online_media.media[].usage.access). CC0 metadata alone is not enough.
providers.label: CC0 — source checked
providers.attribution: Not legally required; credit included: Title, Creator, Smithsonian unit, CC0.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: Media not marked CC0 is skipped (Smithsonian allows only non-commercial use of those).
providers.notes: Without your own free api.data.gov key Visual Atlas uses the shared DEMO_KEY, which is limited to a few requests per hour; add SMITHSONIAN_API_KEY to the .env file in your Visual Atlas folder for more.

providers.name: Wikimedia Commons
providers.rule: Per-file extmetadata LicenseShortName is CC0, Public domain, or CC BY (any version, no SA/NC/ND), with a licence URL for CC BY, an author for CC BY, and no multi-licence ambiguity. Files with a Restrictions value are flagged.
providers.label: Depends on the file: 'Public domain — source checked', 'CC0 — source checked' or 'Free with attribution — credit included'
providers.attribution: CC BY files: author, title, licence name with link, source link — carried into every export.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: CC BY-SA, NC and ND files are excluded from automatic collection (share-alike and non-commercial obligations are not handled yet). Personality-rights or trademark restrictions are shown on the image.
providers.notes: Requests send a descriptive User-Agent and run one at a time. Searches are narrowed with structured-data licence statements (P275/P6216) and every file is still checked individually.

providers.name: Rijksmuseum
providers.rule: The image's own rights statement (VisualItem subject_to) is the Public Domain Mark 1.0, CC0 1.0 or CC BY 4.0. The CC0 on the object's metadata record covers the catalogue data only and is not read.
providers.label: Public domain or CC0 — source checked; CC BY credits Rijksmuseum
providers.attribution: Maker, Title, Date. Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam (object number); CC BY 4.0 images keep the licence link.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: In Copyright and any other rights statement are skipped. Searches match English titles.
providers.notes: Three requests per item (object, VisualItem, DigitalObject); images are IIIF from iiif.micr.io.

providers.name: National Gallery of Art
providers.setup: First search downloads its open data (about 190 MB) and keeps a small index in your library folder.
providers.rule: The Gallery's open data marks the image openaccess = 1 with no maxpixels size cap, and it is the object's primary view. The Gallery releases such images as CC0.
providers.label: CC0 — source checked
providers.attribution: Maker, Title, Date. Courtesy National Gallery of Art, Washington. CC0.
providers.permitted_mode: Download a copy, store locally, display, analyse with AI for this library
providers.restrictions: Rights-restricted and size-capped images are skipped. The index refreshes after 30 days.
providers.notes: No search API: the app searches a local index of the open-data CSV files.

providers.name: Unsplash
providers.reason: API terms require hotlinking images rather than storing copies, and Unsplash's terms bar use in connection with machine-learning or AI datasets. Permission for our store-and-analyse use is unclear.

providers.name: Pexels
providers.reason: Licence allows ordinary reuse, but Pexels prohibits collecting images at scale to train, fine-tune or evaluate AI without permission; whether automated per-image analysis counts is unclear.

providers.name: Pixabay
providers.reason: Terms prohibit data mining and scraping for machine learning; automated collection plus AI analysis is not clearly permitted.

providers.name: NASA Image and Video Library
providers.reason: No per-item rights field. NASA material is generally not copyrighted in the US, but third-party material is marked only in free-text credits and descriptions, so permission cannot be read mechanically.

providers.name: Library of Congress
providers.reason: Rights are free text that varies by collection (rights_advisory, rights_information, collection-level rights), and its 'Free to Use' sets mix public domain, no known copyright and owner-cleared works without a per-item distinction. The JSON API was also blocked by a bot challenge during the check.

providers.name: Openverse
providers.reason: Aggregator that does not verify licences itself; each result would need checking at its original source. Not built yet.
